people.name: Ahitub
people.line: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Saul said, “Hear now, you son of Ahitub.” He answered, “Here I am, my lord.”
translations.bsb: “Listen now, son of Ahitub,” said Saul. “Here I am, my lord,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
translations.asv: And Saul said, Hear now, thou son of Ahitub. And he answered, Here I am, my lord.
